امتطي (form VIII)
# اُمْتُطِيَ (umtuṭiya) /um.tu.tˤi.ja/: third-person masculine singular past passive of اِمْتَطَى (imtaṭā)
# اِمْتَطِي (imtaṭī) /im.ta.tˤiː/: second-person feminine singular imperative of اِمْتَطَى (imtaṭā)
